card.name: Linking words in hypersensitivity and aspirin-triad lists
card.fires_on: Punctuation or linking words just before a list of hypersensitivity or allergy-type features, such as the comma after "asthma" in the aspirin triad or "as" in "such as fever".

modes.label: Comma in aspirin triad
modes.description: The comma after "asthma" in the asthma, rhinitis, nasal polyps syndrome.
modes.example: Patients with the syndrome of asthma<<,>> rhinitis, and nasal polyps

modes.label: "such as" after hypersensitivity
modes.description: The word "as" in "such as" introducing early signs of hypersensitivity like fever or lymphadenopathy.
modes.example: early manifestations of hypersensitivity, such<< as>> fever or lymphadenopathy, may be

modes.label: Verb before rhinitis
modes.description: A verb linking asthmatic patients to rhinitis and nasal polyps in the aspirin triad description.
modes.example: asthmatic patients who<< experience>> rhinitis with or without nasal pol
